name: Integrazo Automator – Integrations for Forms and WooCommerce
author: Plugcrux

sections.description:
Integrazo Automator allows you to connect supported WordPress form plugins and WooCommerce with various CRM, email marketing, and automation platforms.
The plugin enables structured data transfer using secure authentication and API-based communication.

An integration is created by selecting a plugin, choosing a product, authenticating the account, mapping fields, and applying any optional conditions.

Supported Plugins

Integrazo Automator supports the following WordPress form plugins and tools:

  • ARForms
  • Contact Form 7
  • Elementor Forms
  • Everest Forms
  • Fluent Forms
  • Formidable Forms
  • Forminator Forms
  • Gravity Forms
  • HappyForms
  • JetFormBuilder
  • Kali Forms
  • MetForm
  • NEX-Forms
  • Ninja Forms
  • SureForms
  • weForms
  • WooCommerce
  • WordPress Core
  • WPForms
  • WSForm

These supported plugins can be selected during setup to create integrations.

Supported plugins are frequently updated and tested to ensure compatibility with form integration and WooCommerce integration workflows.

Supported Services

Integrazo Automator connects with the following supported services:

  • Brevo (Sendinblue)
  • Freshsales
  • Google Calendar
  • Google Contacts
  • Google Sheets
  • HubSpot CRM
  • Mailchimp
  • MailerLite
  • Moosend
  • Pabbly Connect
  • SendGrid
  • Twilio SMS
  • Zoho Bigin
  • Zoho Campaigns
  • Zoho CRM
  • Zoho Desk
  • Zoho Sheet
  • Zoho Books
  • Zoho Inventory
  • Zoho Invoice

Supported services may vary by account type. You can view all available services in the Select Product popup.

These supported products are used across CRM integration, email list management, spreadsheet recording, and automation workflows.

Connect Service

  1. Go to the Setup page.
  2. Select a supported plugin from the left side.
  3. Select a supported product or service from the right side.
  4. Click Save and Next.

Sign In / Authenticate

  1. Enter an account name.
  2. Follow the instructions shown for the selected product.
  3. Authenticate the account.
  4. Manage multiple authenticated connections in the Accounts tab.

Map Fields

  1. Select a form or WooCommerce event.
  2. Select a list or module based on the chosen service.
  3. Map fields between your plugin and the selected service.
  4. Configure optional Add or Update options.
  5. Apply filter criteria if required.
  6. Save the mapping.

Logs

  • View all integration logs in a structured list.
  • Status values include SUCCESS and RECORD_FAILED.
  • Resync or delete records individually or in bulk.
  • Filter logs by integration, status, or time.
  • View detailed API responses and submitted data.

Settings

General
– Enable Delete Data on Uninstall.
– Configure automatic log cleanup.

Notifications
– Enable email alerts for failed syncs.
– Add multiple notification email addresses.
– Set the email subject line.

Accounts
– View all authenticated accounts.
– Rename or reauthenticate accounts.

Upgrade to Pro

The premium version includes additional features for advanced integrations and expanded field mapping.

Free Version Includes:
– Unlimited integrations
– Supports Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Forms, WordPress, and WooCommerce
– Add-only record creation
– Custom values and system fields
– Log resync for failed records
– Error notifications
– No submission limits

Premium Version Adds:
– Support for additional form plugins
– Add or update record actions
– Custom modules support
– Premium and custom field mapping
– File attachments
– Tags and notes
– Advanced filter conditions
– Extended log features
– Multiple account support

Support

  • Contact Support: https://integrazo.com/pages/contact
  • Feature Request: https://integrazo.com/pages/request-feature

Website: https://integrazo.com/
Email: support@integrazo.com

Additional Notes

This plugin is compatible with WordPress multisite installations.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation
1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
2. In the search bar, type Integrazo and locate this plugin.
3. Click Install and then Activate.

Manual Installation
1. Upload the plugin ZIP file via Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
2. Activate the plugin.
3. Go to the plugin settings and complete the setup.
sections.faq:
Which WordPress form and e-commerce plugins are supported?

The plugin supports a wide range of WordPress form plugins and WooCommerce.
Currently supported plugins include ARForms, Contact Form 7, Elementor Forms, Everest Forms, Fluent Forms, Formidable Forms, Forminator, Gravity Forms, HappyForms, JetFormBuilder, Kali Forms, MetForm, NEX-Forms, Ninja Forms, SureForms, weForms, WPForms, WSForm, WordPress Core, and WooCommerce.
All supported plugins are listed in the Setup page.

Which external services (products) are supported?

Supported products include CRM, email, automation, and spreadsheet tools.
Supported services include HubSpot CRM, Zoho CRM, Zoho Bigin, Zoho Books, Zoho Inventory, Zoho Invoice, Zoho Campaigns, Zoho Desk, Google Sheets, Google Contacts, Mailchimp, MailerLite, SendGrid, Brevo, Twilio SMS, Pabbly Connect, Freshsales, Moosend, and Google Calendar.
All supported products appear in the Select Product popup.

Does the plugin support sending WooCommerce orders to Zoho Inventory?

Yes. WooCommerce order events can sync to Zoho Inventory.
After selecting WooCommerce and Zoho Inventory:
1. Authenticate your Zoho Inventory account.
2. Select a Zoho Inventory module such as Sales Orders.
3. Map WooCommerce fields like customer data, items, totals, and addresses.
4. Save the mapping.

Does the plugin support sending WooCommerce orders to Zoho Books?

Yes. WooCommerce orders can be sent to Zoho Books.
After selecting WooCommerce and Zoho Books:
1. Authenticate your Zoho Books account.
2. Select a module such as Contacts, Sales Orders, or Invoices.
3. Map WooCommerce fields including items, totals, billing, shipping, and customer details.
4. Save the mapping.

Does the plugin support sending WooCommerce orders to Zoho Invoice?

Yes. Zoho Invoice can receive WooCommerce order data.
After selecting WooCommerce and Zoho Invoice:
1. Authenticate your Zoho Invoice account.
2. Select a module such as Invoices or Customers.
3. Map order details including items, totals, taxes, and billing information.
4. Save the mapping.

Can I temporarily disable an integration without deleting it?

Yes. Each integration can be enabled or disabled from the Setup page.

What should I do if a record fails to sync?

Check the Logs page for error details. You may correct the issue and resync the record.
